notes: Stilt-shack plank door (Z-brace) in a grey cypress frame, red Regime padlock on the hasp. Canvas 20x40 (contract 16x32, +25% so 34 px enemies fit). open = 4f@70ms: hasp bursts, door swings out on its left hinge; play once and hold the last frame (dark interior). Enemies emerge from the opening x3..16, y4..39. Origin bottom-centre = deck line.

Hanging oil lantern. idle 4f@140ms flicker. Hook tip is at the top edge (x5..6, y0): to hang it place the sprite at (hookX, hookY + 20) with origin (0.5,1). Flame/light centre (5.5,13) = origin offset (-0.5,-7); add fx glow there. Binary alpha, no baked halo.
Crooked grey shepherd's-hook pole in a mud hummock with a hanging lantern. idle 4f@140ms flicker. Pole foot centred on the origin; lantern light centre (11.5,15) = origin offset (+3.5,-29).
Fishing net strung between two poles: cork/red floats on the head rope, weed snagged in the mesh, a torn hole. idle 4f@180ms gentle sway (lower mesh and weed shift +-1-2 px). Decor, no body.
Dark plank sign on a stake: WADING (orange) / SLOWS YOU (white). Canvas 44x34 (contract 36x34; widened so SLOWS YOU fits the 3x5 font). Board y2..19, stake to the mud at the bottom.
Olive-painted plank sign: LOGS / SINK! with a sinking-log icon and red down arrow. 44x34 (same frame as the other M2 signs).
Whitewashed plank sign: DANGER: / GATOR in red with a red gator-jaws mark; chewed (bite out of the lower-right corner, nibble top-left). 44x34. Den approach.

Hazel's olive flat-bottom skiff, outboard motor at the stern (left), oar, rope coil, red jerry can. idle 4f@160ms bob (frames 3-4 sit 1 px lower). Origin bottom-centre = WATERLINE: only the above-water part is drawn, hull cut flat at the canvas bottom with ripples at both ends. Gunwale top is y11 at the stern, y10 midships, bow tip y6 (frames 1-2); a deck stand height of ~10 px above the water fits (walkable x10..56).

Rusty Regime well-head pipe (cracked flange) in a low mud mound with dead reeds. idle 2f@400ms (faint green wisp); bubble 4f@90ms = the telegraph (mud boils, green glow in the nozzle and crack, gas wisps); burn 2f@80ms = nozzle glowing hot (play with prop_gas_flame on top). Nozzle mouth = x6..9, y2 (centre x8): spawn prop_gas_flame at (vent.x, vent.y - 10).

Swamp-gas flame column: white/yellow core, fire3 band, green weird5/weird4 rim, embers and green sparks. start 3f@60ms (rises to 24/48/72 px), loop 4f@60ms (full 72 px), end 3f@60ms (collapses to 52/28 px then a sputter with drifting sparks). Origin bottom-centre = nozzle. Suggested damage box while looping: [7,4,10,68] (scale the height with start/end: ~24/48 px tall in start f1/f2).

Rusty red Regime fuel drum, dark stencil band with an orange flammable diamond, mud splashed up the chime (no snow). 1 frame each: damaged1 = dents + two leaking bullet holes (hp 2), damaged2 = crumpled rim + leaking flame tongue (hp 1); explode at 0 like prop_explosive_barrel (fx_explosion_m).

Regime warning post: red/pale striped pole on a concrete footing, orange warning triangle with '!', caged red lamp on top. idle 2f@300ms (lamp on / off). Lamp centre (7.5,3) = origin offset (-0.5,-37); add a red fx glow on the 'on' frame.

The beached BAYOU QUEEN: white/red sternwheeler with its back broken at x~100, bow sheared nose-down into the mud, torn red paddlewheel at the stern (left), standing smokestack + a snapped one fallen over the bow, Regime armour plates (one with the spiral eye), fires in the cabin windows, a burning breach in the hull. idle 4f@120ms (fires flicker, smoke plumes drift up-left, embers). Background prop (draw behind the hero; lower contrast, ink1 keyline). The lower ~24 px are dark hull/mud that blend into the ground; origin bottom-centre on the ground line. Smoke-stack mouth ~(152,14) = origin offset (+48,-106); hull-breach fire ~(112,88) = offset (+8,-32) for fx (sparks/light).

Rusted cage pen on a rotten pallet with a crane hook chain on top. intact: bent door with a red padlock; broken: bars torn outward around a ragged hole, door lying in the mud, claw scratches. Bars are see-through (interior x3..28, y5..28). Decor (no body).
Bone pile: ribs, femur, vertebrae and a big gator skull (snout right, teeth), mossy, on a mud bed. Ground decor.

Crushed boats. idle (variant a) = front half of a blue-grey skiff bitten off, stuck bow-up in the mud, splintered bite end, tooth punctures, dangling rope; b = capsized hull, keel up, broken and sagging in the middle with a bite hole and a broken oar. One frame each, decor.

The Drowned Mill's double doors in a heavy timber frame (MILL board on the lintel), iron straps, chained shut with a red Regime padlock, claw gouges and a bite dent. closed (1); shake 4f@60ms loop (leaves jitter, chain jiggles, dust and splinters); smashed 6f@60ms play once and hold the last frame: blast flash in the seam, doors blown outward on their outer hinges, splinters fly, smoke, chain snaps; final = mostly open dark doorway (faint green den glow), wrecked leaves hanging at the sides, splinter pile. Body while closed: [8,8,48,72] (remove on smashed).

The mill's huge broken waterwheel, turning clockwise: 12 board paddles (every third missing), broken outer tip ring, 8 spokes (every second snapped), iron hub; water sheets off the paddles rising on the left, drips and foam at the bottom. spin 8f@120ms seamless loop (11.25 deg/frame, damage repeats every 90 deg). Set piece behind the action. Origin bottom-centre = the lowest paddle tip (it dips into the water); hub centre = origin offset (0,-56).
Decal: three deep claw gouges (dark core, shadowed upper wall, pale fresh-splinter lip), mostly transparent. For walls or ground; flipX for variety.
